_comment: Witnesses for gen_twins.py (--witness-hints) of the iterator's \exists over the whole list: s is the list through the iterator's backward node (or its forward node), walked back to its head and then forward (rac_dll_h_of_member, rac_dll_s_of_h; both stop on a repeated node or after RAC_FUEL steps); b and f are the two nodes' indices in s.  A witness only picks the value to test: the definition's body is still checked at it.
{x} in a witness stands for the witness of binder x (also from an enclosing \exists); gen_twins writes the witnesses in place.  iter_ok's c is the index of cur in s.
iter_ok (owner, 2026-11-08): the list s is a parameter, so only b, f and c need witnesses: the indices of the iterator's two nodes and of cur in s.
